sections.content: How many people are "vehicle valeters and cleaners"?

20,825 people

were counted on the census as "vehicle valeters and cleaners" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Vehicle valeters and cleaners clean, wash and polish the interiors and exteriors of ships, aircraft, trains and road vehicles.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "vehicle valeters and cleaners" there were more men than women (88.5% compared with 11.5%).

This means "vehicle valeters and cleaners" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "elementary administration and service occupations".

Men made up 88.5% and women made up 11.5% of "vehicle valeters and cleaners"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "vehicle valeters and cleaners" included:

  • vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers
  • metal working machine operatives
  • garage managers and proprietors

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "vehicle valeters and cleaners" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "vehicle valeters and cleaners", 13.1% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "vehicle valeters and cleaners" was 65 years or older.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "vehicle valeters and cleaners" included:

  • air-conditioning and refrigeration installers and repairers
  • food, drink and tobacco process operatives
  • security system installers and repairers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "vehicle valeters and cleaners" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "vehicle valeters and cleaners" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "vehicle valeters and cleaners", 8.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (65.7% compared with 34.3%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (65.4%) than self-employed (34.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the North West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
